svg.title: Imaging settings and prior corrections determine intensity correction before unmixing
svg.desc: Standard OME imaging settings and recorded correction history are read first. Supported vendor OriginalMetadata fills required missing fields. Images still requiring correction use full correction when all required values are available. Missing values prompt a choice: supply the missing settings for full correction, or select exposure-only correction and supply any missing exposure times. Images whose metadata records prior calibration including exposure normalization automatically use stored values. Full correction uses Y=(I−o)r/(MgBt), exposure-only uses Y=I/t, and the already-corrected route uses Y=I. The two-band illustrations show counts (61,122) becoming (0.2,0.2) or (61,61); independently calibrated values (0.3,0.7) remain unchanged. The selected values feed per-pixel spectral fitting, SA≈Y, to produce component planes. The caption defines the example settings and reference requirements.
